item.title: Korn's Inequality
item.description: Abstract. In elasticity and viscous-fluid mechanics, energy controls the symmetric part of a vector-field gradient, whereas compactness and well-posedness usually require control of the full gradient. Korn’s inequality bridges this gap after the invisible rigid motions have been removed. This post explains the geometric obstruction, states the principal bounded-domain estimates, and gives a detailed proof of the quotient form using the Poincaré–Lions inequality in $H^{-1}$.
